name: redeemdex
description: RedeemDex browser extension and local Pokémon TCG Live redemption mock.

scripts.build: npm run build:extension && npm run build:mock
scripts.build:extension: vite build --config extension/vite.config.ts && vite build --config extension/vite.background.config.ts && vite build --config extension/vite.content.config.ts
scripts.dev:extension: concurrently --kill-others "vite build --watch --config extension/vite.ui.config.ts" "vite build --watch --config extension/vite.background.config.ts" "vite build --watch --config extension/vite.content.config.ts"
scripts.check: biome check . && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:extension && npm run typecheck:mock
